biography.value:
狼人是殘暴的掠奪者。它們在類人形態下擁有敏銳的感官和火爆的脾氣，還是半熟肉類的愛好者。它們在狼形態時是駭人的掠奪者，但還遠遠不及其半人形態時恐怖彼時它將帶着一身厚實毛皮和發達肌肉的類人身軀，外加上一顆貪婪飢餓的狼頭。狼人在半人形態下可以使用武器，不過它們還是偏好用自己強打的爪子與啃咬來撕裂敵人。
大部分狼人在變過身後沒多久就會逃離文明的土地。那些抗拒詛咒的個體會害怕自己仍留在親友身邊時會發生可怕的事。而那些擁抱詛咒的個體則懼怕自己的謀殺行爲被發現而帶來各種後果。此外，狼人在荒野中還會與狼羣和恐狼結伴行動。

獸化Lycanthropy

作爲最古老最可怕的詛咒之一的獸化，可以將最文明的類人生物變成肆虐的野獸。受詛咒的生物在其天生的類人生物的形態時表現如常。而隨着時間的推移，許多獸化人會擁有其動物形態下的暗示性特徵。靠近觀察時，可以看到它們眼光中閃耀着不尋常的智慧，甚至會在黑暗中發出紅光。
邪惡的獸化人隱藏在羣衆之中，在黑夜中化爲動物形態（尤其是在月圓之夜）然後散佈血腥與恐怖。善良的獸化人居住在其他文明生物附近，因不安而深居簡出，有時還會獨居在遠離村莊和城鎮的荒野地區。

獸化詛咒Curse of Lycanthropy。一個類人生物被獸化人所傷害，或其父母爲獸化人時都會遭受獸化詛咒的感染。法術移除詛咒remove curse可以移除獸化人身上的感染詛咒，但天生獸化人只能靠祈願術wish擺脫該詛咒。
獸化人可以選擇抗拒或接受身上的獸化詛咒。抗拒詛咒時，該獸化人於類人生物形態時將保留其陣營及人格。它可以如常生活，並把獸性衝動與怒氣埋葬在深處。然而，月圓之夜降臨時，詛咒將增強至難以抵拒，並將它轉變成其野獸形態（或是結合了人與獸特質的可怕半人形態）。直到月相漸缺，其體內的獸性才得以再受控制。一些特殊情況裏，如果被詛咒生物未察覺自身的狀況，它有可能不記得自己變身的事，而這些記憶則時常會作爲血腥的夢境困擾着這個獸化人。
一部分人不認爲自己有理由抵抗這些獸化詛咒，且接受自身的存在。假以時日積累經驗後，它們就可以用學會掌握其變形的能力，且可以隨意使用野獸形態或半人形態。大部分擁抱自己獸性的獸化人屈服於嗜血的慾望而變得邪惡，並以此作爲自己投機取巧欺凌弱小的生活本錢。

A werewolf is a savage predator. In its humanoid form, a werewolf has heightened senses, a fiery temper, and a tendency to eat rare meat. Its wolf form is a fearsome predator, but its hybrid form is more terrifying by far-a furred and well-muscled humanoid body topped by a ravening wolf's head. A werewolf can wield weapons in hybrid form, though it prefers to tear foes apart with its powerful claws and bite.

Most werewolves flee civilized lands not long after becoming afflicted. Those that reject the curse fear what will happen if they remain among their friends and family. Those that embrace the curse fear discovery and the consequences of their murderous acts. In the wild, werewolves form packs that also include wolves and dire wolves.

“黑月連隊Company of the Black Moon曾經是忠於王國的冒險者。而現在它們如同狼羣一樣在森林中游蕩。國王已向任何能夠解除其詛咒困擾的人承諾了遺產、頭銜和黃金。個人認爲，這些獎勵於我毫無興趣。”

精靈德魯伊，棘杖Thornstaff

“The Company of the Black Moon—they used to be adventurers loyal to the realm. Now they roam the woods as a pack of werewolves. The king has promised estates, titles, and gold to anyone who can undo the curse afflicting them. I, for one, have no interest in such rewards.”

— Thornstaff, elf druid

Lycanthropes

One of the most ancient and feared of all curses, lycanthropy can transform the most civilized humanoid into a ravening beast. In its natural humanoid form, a creature cursed by lycanthropy appears as its normal self. Over time, however, many lycanthropes acquire features suggestive of their animal form. In that animal form, a lycanthrope resembles a powerful version of a normal animal. On close inspection, its eyes show a faint spark of unnatural intelligence and might glow red in the dark.

Evil lycanthropes hide among normal folk, emerging in animal form at night to spread terror and bloodshed, especially under a full moon. Good lycanthropes are reclusive and uncomfortable around other civilized creatures, often living alone in wilderness areas far from villages and towns.

Curse of Lycanthropy

A humanoid creature can be afflicted with the curse of lycanthropy after being wounded by a lycanthrope, or if one or both of its parents are lycanthropes. A @spell[remove curse] spell can rid an afflicted lycanthrope of the curse, but a natural born lycanthrope can be freed of the curse only with a wish.

A lycanthrope can either resist its curse or embrace it. By resisting the curse, a lycanthrope retains its normal alignment and personality while in humanoid form. It lives its life as it always has, burying deep the bestial urges raging inside it. However, when the full moon rises, the curse becomes too strong to resist, transforming the individual into its beast form-or into a horrible hybrid form that combines animal and humanoid traits. When the moon wanes, the beast within can be controlled once again. Especially if the cursed creature is unaware of its condition, it might not remember the events of its transformation, though those memories often haunt a lycanthrope as bloody dreams.

Some individuals see little point in fighting the curse and accept what they are. With time and experience, they learn to master their shapechanging ability and can assume beast form or hybrid form at will. Most lycanthropes that embrace their bestial natures succumb to bloodlust, becoming evil, opportunistic creatures that prey on the weak.

獸化人玩家角色

一名角色成爲獸化人後，除非被獸化人的種類有特定說明，否則其將保留自己的資料。該角色獲得其非類人形態時的速度、傷害免疫、特質、不涉及裝備的動作項等。該角色擁有其獸化天生攻擊的熟練項（比如啃咬和爪擊），並造成與獸化人資料中所述一樣的傷害。該角色在野獸形態下不能說話。
一個未被獸化的類人生物被帶有獸化詛咒的攻擊命中時必須成功通過一次體質豁免（DC 8＋該獸化人的熟練加值＋該獸化人的體質調整值）以避免受到詛咒。如果該角色主動接受詛咒，則其陣營變成該獸化人的基礎陣營。DM可以自由地決定該角色的陣營改變，直至獸化被移除爲止。
以下爲適用於特定獸化人的信息。

熊人werebear。該角色力量若然未達19則提升至19，以及在熊與半人形態下其AC獲得額外的 +1加值（來自天生護甲）。其天生武器的攻擊檢定和傷害擲骰基於其力量屬性。

野豬人wereboar。該角色力量若然未達17則提升至17，以及在野豬與半人形態下其AC獲得額外的 +1加值（來自天生護甲）。其牙撕Tusks攻擊的攻擊檢定及傷害擲骰基於其力量值。而衝鋒Charge特質的DC則是8＋角色熟練加值＋力量調整值。

鼠人wererat。該角色敏捷若然未達15則提升至15。其啃咬Bite攻擊的攻擊檢定及傷害投骰基於其力量或敏捷屬性中較高值。

虎人weretiger。該角色力量若然未達17則提升至17。其天生武器的攻擊檢定及傷害擲骰基於其力量屬性。猛撲Pounce特質的DC則是8＋角色熟練加值＋力量調整值。

狼人werewolf。該角色力量若然未達15則提升至15，且在狼和半人形態下其AC獲得額外的 +1加值（來自天生護甲）。其天生武器的攻擊檢定和傷害擲骰基於其力量屬性。

Player Characters as Lycanthropes

A character who becomes a lycanthrope retains his or her statistics except as specified by lycanthrope type. The character gains the lycanthrope's speeds in non-humanoid form, damage immunities, traits, and actions that don't involve equipment. The character is proficient with the lycanthrope's natural attacks, such as its bite or claws, which deal damage as shown in the lycanthrope's statistics. The character can't speak while in animal form.

A non-lycanthrope humanoid hit by an attack that carries the curse of lycanthropy must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + the lycanthrope's proficiency bonus + the lycanthrope's Constitution modifier) or be cursed. If the character embraces the curse, his or her alignment becomes the one defined for the lycanthrope. The DM is free to decide that a change in alignment places the character under DM control until the curse of lycanthropy is removed.

The following information applies to specific lycanthropes.

@creature[Werebear]. The character gains a Strength of 19 if his or her score isn't already higher, and a +1 bonus to AC while in bear or hybrid form (from natural armor). Attack and damage rolls for the natural weapons are based on Strength.

@creature[Wereboar]. The character gains a Strength of 17 if his or her score isn't already higher, and a +1 bonus to AC while in boar or hybrid form (from natural armor). Attack and damage rolls for the tusks are based on Strength. For the Charge trait, the DC is 8 + the character's proficiency bonus + Strength modifier.

@creature[Wererat]. The character gains a Dexterity of 15 if his or her score isn't already higher. Attack and damage rolls for the bite are based on whichever is higher of the character's Strength and Dexterity.

@creature[Weretiger]. The character gains a Strength of 17 if his or her score isn't already higher. Attack and damage rolls for the natural weapons are based on Strength. For the Pounce trait, the DC is 8 + the character's proficiency bonus + Strength modifier.

@creature[Werewolf]. The character gains a Strength of 15 if his or her score isn't already higher, and a +1 bonus to AC while in wolf or hybrid form (from natural armor). Attack and damage rolls for the natural weapons are based on Strength.

變體：非人類獸化人

本欄目中提供的資料以人類爲基本生物。不過你亦可以用此資料來表達一個非人類的獸化人，並允許非人類獸化人保留其一項或多項類人生物種族特質，增加其真實感。例如一名精靈狼人可以保留其“妖精血統Fey Ancestry”特質。

Variant: Nonhuman Lycanthropes[–]

The statistics presented in this section assume a base creature of human. However, you can also use the statistics to represent nonhuman lycanthropes, adding verisimilitude by allowing a nonhuman lycanthrope to retain one or more of its humanoid racial traits. For example, an elf werewolf might have the Fey Ancestry trait.

items.name: 多重攻擊（僅類人與半人形態）Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)

description.value:
狼人發動兩次攻擊：兩次矛攻擊（類人形態），或一次啃咬攻擊與一次爪擊攻擊（半人形態）。

The werewolf makes two attacks: two with its spear (humanoid form) or one with its bite and one with its claws (hybrid form).

Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+4]]{+4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 ([[/damage 1d6 + 2 type=piercing]]) damage, or 6 ([[/damage 1d8 + 2 type=piercing]]) damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

狼人可以用一個動作變身成狼與類人生物半人的形態或狼形態，或者以同樣的動作變回其真實形態即類人生物形態。其資料除AC外各個形態均相同。其着裝及攜帶的裝備也不會隨之轉化。死亡時它將恢復其真實形態。

The werewolf can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

items.name: 敏銳嗅聽覺Keen Hearing and Smell

description.value:
狼人依賴聽覺或嗅覺進行的感知（察覺）檢定具有優勢。

The werewolf has advantage on Wisdom (&Reference[skill=Perception]) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
